rationale.edition: All 23 changed file paths live under web/src/ (OSS frontend components, composables, utilities, and the ErrorViewer view) or tests/ui-testing/ (test infrastructure). No path under enterprise/, o2_enterprise/, or src/enterprise/ was touched. The @enterprise tag on the existing sourcemap-ui.spec.js is a Playwright test-filtration label, not a file-path signal — it does not make this an enterprise change. Edition is oss.
rationale.skip: The change modifies user-facing Vue components (ErrorViewer layout restructured to a two-column grid, new ErrorContextCard, ErrorFacetBreakdown, ErrorImpactStrip, ErrorOccurrencesChart components, a redesigned ErrorHeader) and adds new i18n strings. No explicit skip marker (tests-added label or skip comment) was present. The diff is definitely user-facing, so the skip gate is not applied.
rationale.e2e: Six user-facing Vue components were added or meaningfully restructured: ErrorViewer now has a two-column grid with an impact strip, occurrences chart, and side panel (facet breakdown, context card); ErrorHeader was redesigned with new badges, a message banner, deployment chips, and copy actions; four entirely new components (ErrorContextCard, ErrorFacetBreakdown, ErrorImpactStrip, ErrorOccurrencesChart) were introduced. All of these are interactive, data-driven UI surfaces that need E2E validation — the existing sourcemap-ui spec was only minimally updated (method rename) and does not exercise the new detail page structure.
rationale.area: All 23 changed files cluster under the RUM product area: web/src/components/rum/, web/src/composables/rum/, web/src/utils/rum/, and web/src/views/RUM/. The existing Playwright spec that was updated lives at tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/RUM/sourcemap-ui.spec.js. The RUM test area is the only natural home for specs covering the error detail view.
rationale.group: The playwright matrix group is RUM. The enterprise CI matrix overlay (ci_matrix.ent.json) has no RUM entry, meaning the RUM shard lives in the OSS base manifest (ci_matrix.json). The existing sourcemap-ui.spec.js already belongs to that group; a new error-detail.spec.js should join the same shard.
rationale.existing_tests: The diff modifies tests/ui-testing/playwright-tests/RUM/sourcemap-ui.spec.js — a Playwright E2E spec — to rename a page-object method (expectTagsSectionVisible → expectContextSectionVisible) so it stays compatible with the redesigned UI. This is a maintenance update to an existing test, not new coverage for the redesign. No other Playwright E2E specs were changed. The numerous Vitest unit specs (.spec.ts files under web/src/) are unit tests, not E2E coverage, and are not counted here.
